## X-Sense Home Security v1.6.7-2

### MQTT Event Processing
- Reduces repeated entity creation and device lookups during MQTT updates, lowering CPU work in the Home Assistant event loop. (#447)
- Processes received messages in order while giving other Home Assistant work time between updates, rather than applying an entire burst in one callback.
- Avoids rewriting unrelated sensor states for updates that only affect known child devices.
- Keeps device lookups efficient after cloud identifiers change, without changing existing Home Assistant entity identifiers.

### Recovery and Shutdown
- Applies already-received alarm updates before unloading or retiring a connection, while keeping MQTT acknowledgements available during cleanup.
- Improves reconnect cancellation and multi-client cleanup so connections are not left partially retired.
- Prevents shutdown deadlocks and incomplete cleanup when cancellation or overlapping shutdown requests occur.

### Diagnostics
- Adds aggregate MQTT callback timings, message-batch sizes, and queue-depth information without including message contents or credentials.
